assets.purpose: Full logo on a light panel in the dark interface

Prepare production asset: extract the exact entire existing QUAESO logo with the large black Q, mint green offset outlines, mint play triangle, pixel art caped character and mint steps in its counter. Preserve original design, spelling, shapes, relative positions, colors. Remove the white outside background and enormous surrounding blank margins. Do not redesign, do not add elements. Output one transparent PNG logo.

Crisp clean original identity, not a new design. No text or other graphics.
